topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Can you even believe this? I just found out that the Joneses, our neighbors, have been living like they're struggling, but they’ve got more money than Scrooge McDuck! All these years, they’ve been driving that old clunker and growing their own veggies, and turns out, they could buy the whole block if they wanted. I mean, we’ve had potlucks and everything, shared the harvest from our gardens. Did they think it was a fun game to play poor in the fanciest way possible? I don’t get it. What’s the point of all that if you can just live large? Man, I need to process this. Maybe they’ll spill the beans over the fence one of these days.
